linkedin_post.hook: We almost launched with the wrong label. Here is what changed it.
linkedin_post.body:
When we started building Purity Beans, the easiest route in the Indian market was obvious: follow the crowd, use vague descriptions on the front of the pack, and let the back panel disappear into the fine print.

We sat down with our packaging designer and made a different choice.

Transparency is not a marketing strategy. It is a baseline requirement for modern consumers who actually check ingredient lists before buying. If someone picks up Bold, Purista, Purica, or Prima, they deserve to read pure coffee on the panel. sections.heading: Understanding Instant Coffee Granules: Agglomeration vs. Freeze-Drying vs. Spray-Drying
sections.content: Not all instant coffee is created equal in the factory. The method used to dry liquid coffee extract alters both the flavor compounds and the physical behavior of the particles in your cup. Spray drying uses high heat to evaporate water quickly, creating a fine powder that dissolves rapidly but often sacrifices volatile aroma compounds in the process. The result is a dust-like texture that can float on milk, forming a skin that resists stirring. Freeze-drying, used for Purity Beans Purica, freezes liquid extract and removes water through sublimation in a vacuum, locking in delicate aromas and producing distinct crystalline chunks. These crystals dissolve more slowly but deliver exceptional aromatic clarity — ideal for black coffee drinkers who want to taste every note. Agglomeration, used for Purity Beans Ultra Blend and Bold, takes fine coffee particles and fuses them into porous, cluster-like granules. This porous structure allows liquid — whether water or milk — to penetrate the granule instantly, ensuring rapid dissolution without clumping or sticky residue. Purity Beans chooses agglomeration for Ultra Blend because it solves the real problem Indian milk coffee drinkers face: powder that refuses to dissolve cleanly in hot milk. The result is a smooth, consistent cup every single time, with no floating islands or gritty sediment at the bottom. Purity Beans Ultra Blend delivers this experience at a price that makes daily cafe-quality milk coffee accessible. Shop Ultra Blend at https://p3online.in.
